title: Weapons Expanded: Editions
description: This is an Addon for Weapons expanded adding new weapons and etc
body:
# Weapons Expanded: Editions 

Weapons Expanded: Editions is a Fabric addon for Better Combat and Weapons Expanded. The goal of this mod is to add unique weapons, variants, and special editions that fit naturally alongside existing combat content.

The first addition currently added is the Bl1xickle, a custom sickle designed with dual-wield combat in mind. Future updates may introduce additional weapons, reimagined variants, and other experimental combat equipment.

Requires Better Combat and Weapons Expanded.

(Also My first mod without mcreator!)
